memory_updates.future_rule:
2026-11-05 process lesson: Do not grandfather an owned position because it made money, its entry is favorable or its old invalidation has not printed while demanding much stronger proof from a new idea. Ask what would be initiated from flat at current forward risk and size. A narrower forward edge can justify reducing even when the original thesis remains directionally valid. Harvest as remaining edge closes, consider time exits for failed repricing, and reassess residuals rather than holding indefinitely for the original target.

November 6 lifecycle review: Record entry and original rationale, then every material change since entry, including new reasons unrelated to the original thesis that can strengthen or kill the trade. An intact original hypothesis does not earn retention. For a winner assess remaining central and credible best-case profit, their plausibility, the horizon and how much open profit to surrender to pursue the larger case. For a loser assess recovery versus further loss and the additional loss worth accepting. Breakeven is not an economic target, and a cheaper price alone does not justify adding. Compare retaining each exposure with closing or replacing it. Do not silently extend targets, widen an exit or reset the clock because the position is losing.

memory_updates.future_rule:
2026-11-05 process lesson: Every serious proposal, including HOLD, needs a judgment-supported target range, intended repricing horizon, normal-movement yardstick, fundamental falsifier, practical exit/review, initial exposure, target payoff, planned-exit loss, worse gap/stress and same-horizon financing assumptions. Establish a dollar loss budget and derive size from credible adverse movement and portfolio context, not unused capacity. Distinguish an eventual policy outcome from a weeks/months trading target. A volatility band is not a target or a probability; a favorable reward/stop ratio is not expected value. Stops can be hit by ordinary noise and do not guarantee a loss cap.

November 6 mandatory event/scenario review: Every recommendation must name upcoming scheduled data and policy events, including the next immediate release, before choosing size. Forecasting a print is optional; explaining favorable, adverse and mixed outcomes for the book is mandatory. Separate the most likely profit case from a credible best case and state its qualitative likelihood without invented probabilities; compare both with foreseeable loss paths and timing. A known inflation release is not interchangeable with an uncertain peace or equity-crash catalyst. A narrow research target is not the full opportunity set. Profit protection is dollar giveback, not a percentage move in rates: at the research reference3.05125 the remaining100m CORRA had about348750 open gross profit;110000 giveback corresponds to11bp at10000/bp and rate3.16125. After cutting size in half, keep the chosen rate exit rather than widen it to spend the former dollar budget. Use actual trusted fill when describing forward sensitivities. Daily decisions, gaps and slippage can exceed the intended loss; a saved management level is not a resting order.
